Work No.01

paandaa

A landing page for a dynamic island app on Windows, built to make an unfamiliar idea feel calm and obvious on the first screen.

View live site ↗
Role
Design, copy, build
Built with
HTML, CSS, JS · Vercel
Languages
English, Indonesian
Year
2026
paandaa-notch.vercel.app

Scroll inside the previews to read the whole page, or open the live site.

The problem

People know the dynamic island from phones, but not on Windows. The page had to show it working before explaining anything.

The approach

The hero is the real island, opening on hover or tap. Every section uses real app screens, one green accent and plain words in English and Indonesian.

The result

One page that shows, explains and sells: pay what you want on Gumroad, with auto-updates and a short FAQ for SmartScreen and privacy questions.
